headword: {猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}

definitions.explanation: A four-character idiom describing someone who plunges ahead toward a goal without considering risks or alternatives. Literally 'charging like a wild boar.' Can be praising (single-minded drive) or critical (reckless), depending on context.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}{型|がた}だ。
{猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{性格|せいかく}→性格：03371_seikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{災|わざわ}い→災い：27851_wazawai⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{向|む}かって→向かう：01186_mukau⟧{猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{時|とき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{立|た}ち{止|ど}まって→立ち止まる：04636_tachidomaru⟧⟦{考|かんが}える→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧だ。
examples.english: Charging headlong toward your goal is fine, but sometimes you need to stop and think.

notes:
A ⟦{四字熟語|よじじゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧ (four-character idiom): {猪突|ちょとつ} (boar-charge) + {猛進|もうしん} (fierce advance). The image is of a wild boar plowing forward in a straight line.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to charge headlong
- {猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}{型|がた}: the headlong-charging type (of person)
- {猪突猛進|ちょとつもうしん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な: headlong; reckless (as a modifier)

REGISTER:
Used in both writing and speech, especially when characterizing personality. Often appears in self-deprecating or warning contexts: 'I just rush in without thinking.' Can carry a positive nuance of drive and determination, or a negative one of recklessness — context decides.
